headline: Both Alabama quarterbacks are injured and will not play against Georgia
fairReason: Alabama losing both quarterbacks drastically reduces their win probability against Georgia.
analysis: This news significantly hurts Alabama's chances because both of their quarterbacks, critical for offensive success, are out for the game. Since the YES outcome means Alabama wins, losing both quarterbacks makes Alabama less likely to win against Georgia, whose quarterback situation is unchanged.
